author: Johnboy4g63
title: Come for the Graphics, Stay for the Disappointment
content:
Are you looking for a game that will frustrate you to no end and blow through your coins faster than the government blows tax money? Then boy, do I have the perfect dumpster fire for you.

Monopoly Slots is a masterclass in how not to design a game. The payouts are so stingy you’d think you were dipping into the developers’ personal savings. Every spin feels like the game is patting you on the head saying, “Awww… you wanted to win? That’s adorable.”

You’ll watch your coin balance vanish faster than honesty in politics. The few tiny “wins” you get are basically participation trophies—just enough to keep you spinning while the game quietly mugs you in the background.

By the time you realize what’s happening, your coins are gone, your patience is gone, and your will to live might be on thin ice too. But hey—at least the graphics are nice, right?
(They’d better be, since they’re the only thing you’ll actually get out of this.)

If you enjoy disappointment, frustration, and the thrilling joy of watching numbers go down instead of up, congratulations—you’ve found your dream app.

Everyone else? Run.

author: NashvilleNewman
title: A review from Level 647
content:
I have played this game extensively and currently am at level 647. I’ve stuck with it purely as an experiment to see if there were any problems or patterns with the game and so I could write an honest review having played it for more than a week.

I guarantee any review you read that says “I don’t know why all the negative reviews” are either plants who’ve been compensated to write those reviews or they haven’t played this game more than a week. 

Anyway, I could say many things about the game but one thing I can say unequivocally is this slot is brutally unforgiving. 

I understand they’re trying to make money through the in app purchases for coins to play. I get it. However, the ratio of bonuses you hit compared to the number of times you’ll be spinning to try and get that bonus / free games is WILDLY off. Seriously, I’ve had better luck in an actual casino. 

I don’t want to win all the time of course, as that would be boring and take the rush out of hitting the free play but when you don’t win (and you won’t a LOT) and run out of coins, you’re then forced to tap an X twice to get out of the purchase menu. Then a piggy bank appears which you need to tap another 6 times to break open for a measly 250k coins which is enough for ONE spin on a slot. So that’s 8 taps for one spin. I’m sure it’s only a matter of time before Phantom EFX gets slapped with a class action lawsuit for causing a repetitive stress disorder. No im not joking. It’s actually ridiculous. No other slot that I’ve ever played made you work so hard for extra coins. 

There are nice slot machines here as Monopoly was all the rage in the casinos a bunch of years back but unless they tweak the game this one is really not worth the pain (literally and figuratively) you’ll be put though.

content: I enjoy the tasks and building up the beat up streets. I enjoy the storyboard, it really brings the board game to life to play it as a casino game. I think it’s visually appealing and a fun pass time. it’s fun to earn the  5th house or Red Hotel and increase The ticket amount reward and continue to build. I also enjoy the featured games on the boardwalk or high limit area which ever you choose you can count on seeing a lot of these slot machines when you visit places like Reno Nevada, Eldorado Hotel and casino, Circus Circus Hotel and casino or Stockton ca. sky river casino. 👍🏽👍🏽⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Fallgirl123
title: Don’t play this game
content: This game can be really fun. But, all it has turned into is a money grab. The slots don’t pay off at all. Believe me. I’be spent money on here and gotten nothing in return. Spend your money elsewhere. All you get from this game is heartache!

author: Meleanna1
title: Used to love this game.
content: Once you hit like level 50 or 60 every game that gives the tokens you need to forward the story has a minimum bid of 800,000. That blows through the money so fast, it isn’t fun any more. 300k to 400k every two hours means 1 play every 4 hours. I’ll never get to the story without paying real money. Too bad. I was really enjoying the story.
